channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Wartime airfield that transformed Norfolk hamlet to feature in talk
item.description: A wartime airfield that reshaped a quiet Norfolk parish will be the focus of a talk later this month.

item.title: Plans to repair historic windmill among public notices this week
item.description: Plans to repair the historic Gayton Windmill near King's Lynn and build 550 homes near Cromer are among the public notices in Norfolk this week.

item.title: Probe into man's death after fire suspended amid criminal investigation
item.description: An inquest into a man who died after a fire at his home in Walcott has been suspended.

item.title: Parents call for road closure at school bedevilled by 'selfish drivers'
item.description: Parents are calling for a road outside the Lionwood infant and junior schools to be closed at drop-off and pick-up times, after years of problems with traffic.

item.title: Seaside town named one of UK's best places to visit
item.description: Southwold in Suffolk has been named one of the best places in the country to visit during winter by The Sun.

item.title: Police increasing patrols around Hay Hill after rise in call outs
item.description: Police were called out to the square near Primark and McDonalds 386 times in 2025. The area reopened to the public after a £3.2m revamp in 2024.

item.title: Developer caused devastating flooding by building road across waterway
item.description: Some of Norfolk's worst flash flooding in recent years was caused by builders on a nearby housing development blocking a stream, an official report has found.

item.title: Drinking at office Christmas party costs man his driving licence
item.description: Kester Fentiman was caught driving on the A11 at Mildenhall while he was more than twice the limit. He was banned from driving at Suffolk Magistrates' Court.

item.title: Anger over 'tasteless' name given to project which could see care homes sold
item.description: Council officials have distanced themselves from a "tasteless" name used for plans which could see Norfolk care homes sold.

item.title: How to stay germ free at the peak time for coughs and colds
item.description: Coughs and sore throats - Column by Christine Webber
